backend/main.mo: Actor module with authorization mixin, user/profile data models, ranking logic, and functions for profile retrieval and saving.
backend/validation.mo: Validation utilities enforcing name rules including length, character set, and reserved-word checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature requirements to impacted frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend source files across the app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global stylesheet defining light/dark theme CSS variables and base styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point bootstrapping the React app with root container and script loader.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component handling routing, theme initialization, profile sync, daily reminders, and global UI structure.
frontend/src/backup/backupIO.ts: Backup import/export utilities using JSON serialization, schema validation, and migration handling.
frontend/src/backup/backupSchema.ts: Backup schema, validation logic, and migration rules ensuring compatibility with new settings and fields.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Circul: Animated circular progress component using SVG circles with color based on percentage and optional label.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Subjec: Displays subject attendance stats with indicators, streaks, trends, and a circular progress meter.
Provides the main app layout with header, content area, and fixed bottom footer handling safe spacing.
frontend/src/components/markToday/MarkTo: Bottom sheet for marking today's classes by loading scheduled periods and saving attendance statuses.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Botto: Five‑tab bottom navigation bar with icons, active‑state styling, and tab change handling.
frontend/src/components/pastAttendance/M: Flow to select a past date, load scheduled classes, and mark attendance with validation and saving.
frontend/src/components/settings/AboutCa: About section card showing branding logo, version info, and founder details with theme‑aware logo.
frontend/src/components/settings/BackupR: Backup and restore card enabling JSON export/import with confirmation before restoring state.
frontend/src/components/settings/LogoutC: Logout card with a confirmation dialog that triggers local logout even if backend deletion fails and manages loading state.
frontend/src/components/settings/Notific: Manages browser notification settings with permission handling, preference toggles, and test notification sending.
frontend/src/components/settings/Profile: Editable profile name component with validation, save/cancel flow, and error display.
frontend/src/components/settings/TargetP: Control for adjusting target attendance percentage via slider and numeric input.
frontend/src/components/settings/ThemeSe: UI for selecting light/dark/system themes and choosing a color variant.
frontend/src/components/subjects/Confirm: Reusable confirmation dialog for destructive actions with customizable title, description, and action label.
frontend/src/components/subjects/Subject: Dropdown menu offering edit, reset, and delete actions for a subject.
Dialog for creating or editing a subject with validation and automatic ID/color assignment for new subjects.
frontend/src/components/system/ErrorBoun: React error boundary that classifies auth errors and shows session-expired or generic recovery UI with reload option.
frontend/src/components/system/InitialLo: Animated splash screen showing the app logo and loading indicators, reacting to theme changes.
frontend/src/components/system/NonBlocki: Hook-based toast component that shows non-blocking error notifications.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceCalculatio: Pure utilities for computing attendance stats, safe bunk counts, targets, insights, and streaks.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceReducer.ts: Reducer managing subjects, events, timetable, exchanges, settings, user profile, and gamification actions.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceTypes.ts: Type definitions for subjects, events, settings, user profiles, gamification, and the app state.
frontend/src/domain/premiumInsights.ts: Generates predictive attendance insights, trend direction, and streak-based motivational messages.
frontend/src/domain/scheduleForDate.ts: Computes the scheduled classes for a date by applying timetable and exchange overrides.
frontend/src/domain/streakMilestones.ts: Calculates continuous day streaks and determines milestone awards based on streak history.
Validates and normalizes display names with length and character rules.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates a backend actor based on the current identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthRecovery.ts: Provides logout and error‑handling helpers that clear app state, caches, and identity sessions.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailyAttendanceRem: Schedules and sends a daily 7 PM attendance reminder notification if attendance isn’t marked.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity login, stored identity loading, and context state for authentication.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles with custom theme variables, animations, and motion‑reduction settings.
frontend/src/lib/authErrorHandling.ts: Classifies authorization errors into user‑safe messages and identifies when logout is required.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Provides branding constants and functions returning theme‑aware logo asset paths.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Contains small utilities for class merging, IDs, dates, colors, and date comparisons.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/notifications/localNotifica: Generates notification messages for class marking actions based on status counts.
frontend/src/notifications/notifications: Wraps the browser Notifications API with permission checks, error handling, and optional click handlers.
frontend/src/notifications/reminderFailu: Provides rate‑limited, user‑friendly messages for notification failures using localStorage tracking.
frontend/src/pages/HomeDashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard page showing attendance stats and issuing milestone rewards, including optional browser notifications.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Simple name‑based login form with validation and profile creation.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Settings UI for profile editing, notification prefs, theme, backups, and a resilient logout flow.
frontend/src/pages/StatsPage.tsx: Displays overall attendance statistics with visual summaries and breakdown cards.
frontend/src/pages/SubjectDetailsPage.ts: Displays subject details with attendance stats, safe‑bunk/required calculators, recent activity, and edit/delete/reset actions.
frontend/src/pages/TimetablePage.tsx: Renders a weekly timetable grid with edit mode for assigning subjects to each time slot.
frontend/src/rank/ConfettiBurst.tsx: Generates a lightweight confetti overlay with randomized particle positions and timings.
frontend/src/rank/rankApi.ts: Provides deprecated compatibility wrappers around RankingService for submitting points and fetching weekly rankings.
frontend/src/rank/RankBadge.tsx: Shows styled rank badges, giving special designs to ranks 1–3 and gradient badges for others.
frontend/src/rank/rankCache.ts: Handles saving, loading, and clearing weekly ranking cache data in localStorage with validation.
frontend/src/rank/RankingModel.ts: Defines ranking UI models and mapping/validation helpers for backend ranking data.
frontend/src/rank/RankingRepository.ts: Provides paginated fetching and submission of ranking data from the backend canister.
frontend/src/rank/RankingScreen.tsx: Main leaderboard UI with polling, error handling, auto-scroll to user, and optional confetti for top ranks.
frontend/src/rank/RankingService.ts: Implements ranking fetch, caching fallback, auth-aware error handling, page loading, and point submission logic.
frontend/src/rank/RankPage.tsx: Loads actor and user context, then renders the main RankingScreen component.
frontend/src/state/appStore.tsx: Defines the global React app state provider with IndexedDB-backed persistence and reset-aware saving behavior.
frontend/src/state/persistence.ts: Loads and saves app state to IndexedDB, validating structure and merging defaults for new settings fields.
frontend/src/storage/indexedDbClient.ts: Implements low-level IndexedDB operations for storing, retrieving, and clearing the app state.
frontend/src/theme/themeManager.ts: Applies and initializes theme settings, including dark mode and variant handling with system preference listeners.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters, supporting both query and hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, colors, animations, plugins, and dark mode behavior.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s versioned state, architectural guidelines, new feature scopes, known issues, and existing features for upgrading the BunkPro app. Acts as a central specification for attendance, notifications, ranking logic, branding, and stability requirements.
